title: MaddieCraft Lite
description: Lightwight highly optimized modpack to use in Maddie's minecraft server that keeps it vanilla and adds shader support along with bug fixes and optimizations
body:
Client side modpack to use in mc.maddiekuma.com
It's a lightweight version of the full modpack that keeps things more vanilla not changing much visually or adding any sounds or big gameplay tweaks. It's for people who like minecraft as it is to have a lot of optimization mods and have shader and voice chat support.
